About AIMD

Digital forensics for a synthetic media world.

AIMD helps investigators understand what an image can and cannot tell them. It connects machine learning with artifact-level evidence and makes uncertainty part of the product.

Evidence first

The interface keeps raw signals and explanations close to the verdict.

No false certainty

Unavailable or conflicting evidence produces an honest inconclusive assessment.

Built to extend

The pipeline leaves room for calibrated validation, provenance, video, and audio analysis.
